completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: on_command with command="tutor_start_session" resolves to start_session via tool_to_command and invokes MCPAdapter.tutor_start_session (Bug #2 regression guard).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented Bug #2 alias resolution in CommandRouter._dispatch_command: `resolved_command = self.tool_to_command.get(command, command)` runs before the _command_map lookup. Test test_on_command_alias_resolves_tutor_start_session passes — sends a CommandPayload with command='tutor_start_session', asserts mcp_adapter.tutor_start_session is awaited once with student_id='lilymay', and that no other handler fires. Pulls the alias map from get_role('tutor').tool_to_command per the implementation note's single-source-of-truth requirement.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: on_command with command="start_session" (canonical) bypasses the alias map and works directly (passthrough behaviour).
completion_promises.evidence: The .get(c, c) form is the passthrough idiom: canonical names are absent from tool_to_command (which only maps MCP tool names) so they fall through unchanged. Test test_on_command_canonical_command_passes_through sends command='start_session' and asserts the same adapter.tutor_start_session call lands. Both AC-001 and AC-002 hold simultaneously without duplicating dispatch keys.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: _publish_result with reply_to="_INBOX.abc" calls client.publish_raw("_INBOX.abc", ...) AND publishes to agents.result.gcse-tutor (Bug #1 regression guard).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented Bug #1 dual-publish in CommandRouter._publish_result: when reply_to is set, raw-publishes ResultPayload.model_dump_json().encode() to the inbox, then ALWAYS also publishes the canonical envelope to Topics.resolve(Topics.Agents.RESULT, agent_id='gcse-tutor') = 'agents.result.gcse-tutor'. Test test_publish_result_with_reply_to_publishes_both asserts both client.publish_raw and client.publish are awaited; raw body is parseable as ResultPayload (raw on the wire, not envelope-wrapped) — the exact wire format jarvis's dispatch.py expects.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: _publish_result with reply_to=None only publishes to the canonical result topic.
completion_promises.evidence: Test test_publish_result_without_reply_to_only_canonical asserts client.publish_raw is NOT awaited and client.publish is awaited exactly once on subject 'agents.result.gcse-tutor'. The reply_to=None branch in _publish_result skips the raw-publish entirely and runs only the canonical envelope publish path.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: unknown command name returns ResultPayload(success=False, error=...) and the error message includes the list of supported commands.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented UnsupportedCommandError(KeyError) raised by _dispatch_command for unknown commands; on_command catches it and synthesises ResultPayload(success=False, result={'error': ..., 'error_type': 'UnsupportedCommandError'}). Two tests pin this: test_dispatch_command_raises_unsupported_command_error verifies the inner contract (raises with sorted supported list); test_on_command_unknown_command_returns_error_result verifies the outer contract (no propagation, error string contains 'bogus_command' and every canonical command name: start_session, tutor_turn, session_status, end_session).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: handler exception is caught and surfaces as ResultPayload(success=False, error=...) (no propagation past on_command).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented boundary catch in CommandRouter._safe_invoke: any exception from the underlying MCP method is captured into ResultPayload(success=False, result={'error': str(exc), 'error_type': type(exc).__name__}); the original traceback goes to logger.exception. Test test_on_command_handler_exception_caught wires mcp_adapter.tutor_start_session.side_effect = RuntimeError('boom'), calls on_command (must not raise), and asserts the published ResultPayload.success is False with 'boom' in error and error_type='RuntimeError'.
